nodes.name: Temperature and Humidity Sensing
nodes.function: Reads air temperature and humidity from a DHT22 sensor wired to the Arduino Uno sensor node, once per loop iteration (about every second)

nodes.name: Soil Moisture Sensing
nodes.function: Reads the soil moisture level from an analog soil moisture sensor wired to the Arduino Uno sensor node, once per loop iteration

nodes.name: Measurement Packaging
nodes.function: On the Arduino Uno, formats the latest temperature, humidity and soil moisture values into one space-separated text line

nodes.name: Sensor Command Handler
nodes.function: On the Arduino Uno, interprets single-character commands received over Bluetooth ('h', 't', 'm') and replies with the requested humidity, temperature or soil moisture value

nodes.name: Sensor Bluetooth Link
nodes.function: HC-05 Bluetooth module on the Arduino Uno (serial, 9600 baud): transmits one measurement line every second and receives commands from the mobile app

nodes.name: Device Discovery
nodes.function: In the Android app, lists bonded Bluetooth devices, discovers nearby devices and lets the farmer select the sensor node

nodes.name: App Bluetooth Connection
nodes.function: In the Android app, opens a Bluetooth serial connection to the selected sensor node, receives its byte stream and sends outgoing commands

nodes.name: Stream Parsing
nodes.function: In the Android app, removes backspace control characters from the received bytes, splits the stream into lines and each line into temperature, humidity and soil moisture values

nodes.name: Measurement Aggregation
nodes.function: In the Android app, keeps a sliding window of the last 10 readings of each measurement and computes their mean values

nodes.name: Dashboard Display
nodes.function: In the Android app, shows tiles with the mean temperature, humidity and soil moisture, plus a rainfall tile with a placeholder value

nodes.name: Temperature Trend Chart
nodes.function: In the Android app, draws a line chart of the temperature readings in the current sliding window

nodes.name: Command Input
nodes.function: In the Android app, text field where the farmer types a command that is sent to the sensor node
